a-plastic-buff-firing-missouri-fireclay-: Fireclay Missouri ah oo plastic ah, ku gubta midab buff ah, laga iibiyo shiidid 20, 35, 40 iyo 50 mesh ah. Inta badan waa dhoobo jirka; qiimayaashu waa kuwa caadiga u ah dhoobo dabiici ah.
a-blended-iron-bearing-slip-clay-1wfl7qj: Slip clay isku-dhafan oo bir (iron) leh oo Plainsman samaysay tan iyo 1988 beddelka Albany slip. Keligiis wuxuu cone 10 ku dhalaalaa oo noqdaa bunni ifaya (tenmoku marka reduction la gubo), cone 6-na wuxuu u baahan yahay qiyaastii 20% frit; habab boqolkiiba sare leh isticmaal isku-dar la dubay iyo mid ceeriin ah si aad uga hortagto dillaacyada qallajinta.
a-silty-iron-rich-new-york-oucatm: Dhoobo New York ah oo dhoobo-ciideed (silty) ah, bir (iron) badan leh, oo keligeed ku dhalaali jirtay glaze bunni madow oo ifaya cone 8 ilaa 10, kuna jirta kumanaan habab hore. Lama soo saarin tan iyo dabayaaqadii 1980-meeyadii; meesheeda isticmaal Alberta Slip.
leadless-low-alumina-calcium-sodium-boro: Calcium-sodium borosilicate frit aan rasaas (lead, Pb) lahayn, alumina yar leh; frit-ka ugu isticmaalka badan habab glaze ee Waqooyiga Ameerika, inta badan isha boron iyo calcium. Dhalaalid 1450 F, qulqul 1600 F, CTE 9.47 (Ferro 2008).
non-hazardous-glass-powder-per-supplier-: Budo dhalo ah oo aan khatar lahayn sida SDS-ka alaab-qeybiyuhu sheegayo; iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-a-balance: Calcium borosilicate frit leh kiimiko isku-dheellitiran oo glaze u eg (waxaa ku jira qiyaastii 10% alumina); xoogaa kaolin ah marka lagu daro wuxuu ku dhowaad noqdaa glaze low-fire ah oo dhammaystiran. Dhalaalid 1600 F, qulqul 1750 F, CTE 7.94 (Ferro 2008).
high-sodium-low-boron-high-expansion-ggm: Frit sodium badan, boron yar, ballaarasho sare leh; isha soda ee caadiga ah kulayl kasta iyo glaze-yada crystalline. Dhalaalid 1400 F, qulqul 1700 F, CTE 10.08 (Ferro 2008).
well-balanced-high-boron-calcium-borosil: Calcium borosilicate frit boron badan oo si fiican u dheellitiran; qiyaastii 85 frit iyo 15 kaolin waxay sameeyaan glaze hufan (clear) cone 04. Dhalaalid 1500 F, qulqul 1700 F, CTE 7.16 (Ferro 2008).
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit aan alkali lahayn, ballaarasho kulayl oo aad u yar leh (CTE qiyaastii 4.0); waxaa loo isticmaalaa 3-10% si loo daaweeyo crazing iyo isha MgO ee si fudud u dhalaasha. Dhalaalid 1900 F, qulqul 2300 F (Ferro 2003).
high-alkali-almost-calcium-free-alkali-3: Alkali borosilicate frit alkali badan, ku dhowaad aan calcium lahayn, oo leh xoogaa zinc iyo fluorine ah; ballaarasho sare, waxaa loo isticmaalaa glaze-yada crackle iyo midabada alkaline. Dhalaalid 1400 F, qulqul 1500 F, CTE 9.98 (Ferro 2008).
contains-about-1-5-fluorine-which-q7b1ho: Waxaa ku jira qiyaastii 1.5% fluorine, oo ka bixi kara gubidda; hawo sii kiln-ka. Haddii kale waa budo dhalo ah oo khatar yar.
artware-flux-calcium-borosilicate-frit-f: Calcium borosilicate frit oo ah flux-ka artware; u-dhigmaha Fusion ee liiska ugu qoran Vibrantz 3134. Marka loo eego 3134-2 (Ferro 2008): Al2O3 -1.20, B2O3 +1.01, SiO2 -0.56, CaO +0.49, Na2O +0.26 dhibcood; wax yar ayuu ka qulqul badan yahay marka uu dhalaalo.
boro-calcium-dinnerware-frit-fusion-s-lb: Frit boro-calcium ah oo loogu talagalay weelasha cuntada; u-dhigmaha Fusion ee liiska ugu qoran Vibrantz 3124. high-calcium-boron-leadless-frit-fusion-: Frit calcium badan, boron leh, aan rasaas lahayn; u-dhigmaha Fusion ee liiska ugu qoran Vibrantz 3195. high-sodium-low-boron-frit-fusion-16l28b: Frit sodium badan, boron yar; u-dhigmaha Fusion ee liiska ugu qoran Vibrantz 3110 waana kan ugu dhow u-dhigmayaashan: oksaydh kastaa wuxuu ku jiraa 0.26 dhibcood gudahood ee 3110-2 (Ferro 2008). alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit aan alkali lahayn, ballaarasho aad u yar leh (CTE 3.96), loo isticmaalo ka hortagga crazing; u-dhigmaha Fusion ee liiska ugu qoran Vibrantz 3249. natural-sodium-calcium-borate-ore-colema: Macdan sodium-calcium borate ah oo dabiici ah (colemanite iyo ulexite oo leh dhoobo hectorite u eg), muddo dheer flux-ka boron ee ugu weyn ee low-fire iyo mid-fire ee habab Maraykanka. low-hazard-nuisance-dust-avoid-breathing: Boodh dhib leh oo khatar yar; iska ilaali neefsashadiisa.
blended-cornish-china-clay-from-imerys-6: Cornish china clay isku-dhafan oo ka yimid Imerys, titania aad u yar iyo qiyaastii 2% K2O leh, sidaas darteed wuxuu ku gubtaa cad-buluug. Waa kaolin-ka caadiga ah ee jirka porcelain ee UK iyo habab glaze badan oo UK ah.
fine-dust-may-contain-traces-of-1caabb5: Boodh jilicsan; waxaa ku jiri kara raadad silica kiristaal ah.
imerys-cornish-china-clay-with-more-1xib: Cornish china clay Imerys ah oo ka plastic badan, bir (iron) iyo potash wax yar ka yar leh marka loo eego Grolleg; aad buu cad ugu gubtaa. Waxaa loo sameeyay jirka porcelain, glaze-yadana loo isticmaalaa sida kaolin kasta.
imerys-calcined-cornish-china-clay-about: Cornish china clay Imerys ah oo calcined ah (qiyaastii 55% mullite, 45% dhalo). high-silica-devon-ball-clay-with-all38y: Ball clay Devon ah oo silica badan, plastic fiican, xoog dhexdhexaad ah iyo bir (iron) yar leh; wuxuu ku gubtaa buff fool-maroodi (ivory) u eg. Ball clay caadi ah oo ku jira glaze-yada iyo slip-yada UK.
dorset-ball-clay-with-high-strength-cu8i: Ball clay Dorset ah oo xoog badan oo bir (iron) xoogaa sarreysa leh (qiyaastii 2.3% Fe2O3), loo isticmaalo jirka stoneware ee midabka diirran iyo glaze-yada iyo slip-yada UK qaarkood.
low-plasticity-white-firing-ball-clay-2z: Ball clay plastic yar oo cad ku gubta, oo Potclays iibiso, caan ku ah jirka stoneware; wuxuu ku gubtaa ka cad TWVA.
blend-of-medium-plasticity-white-firing-: Isku-dar ball clay-yo plastic dhexdhexaad ah oo cad ku gubta. Potclays waxay u iibisaa beddelka ESVA ball clay, oo soo saarayaashu joojiyeen.
potclays-potash-feldspar-almost-no-soda-: Potash feldspar-ka Potclays: ku dhowaad soda ma leh, silica xor ahna wuu ka badan yahay, sidaas darteed alumina ka yar ayuu leeyahay inta badan potash spar-yada. Qiimayaashu waa bartamaha xadadka la daabacay.
long-standing-uk-catalogue-figures-for-q: Tirooyinka catalogue-ga UK ee muddada dheer ee potash feldspar, oo ay daabaceen Potterycrafts, Bath Potters iyo CTM. Bath Potters waxay sheegtaa in potash feldspar-keedu yahay Norwiiji.
potterycrafts-data-sheet-for-p3296-octob: Warqadda xogta Potterycrafts ee P3296 (October 2025) waxay bixisaa falanqaynta Sibelco ee Norflux K 11 (K₂O 11.8, Na₂O 2.9), sidaas darteed kaydkooda hadda wuxuu noqon karaa feldspar-kaas: eeg Norflux Potash Feldspar.
valentine-clays-potash-feldspar-a-typica: Potash feldspar-ka Valentine Clays, potash spar caadi ah oo leh qiyaastii 10.4% K2O iyo 2.3% Na2O.
spanish-sodium-feldspar-albite-with-almo: Sodium feldspar Isbaanish ah (albite) oo ku dhowaad aan potash lahayn, oo Potclays, Potterycrafts iyo Valentine ku iibiyaan falanqayn isku mid ah. Flux ka xoog badan, kana hooseeya kulaylka dhalaalidda potash feldspar.
the-soda-feldspar-figures-printed-by-pm7: Tirooyinka soda feldspar ee ay daabaceen Bath Potters iyo CTM; Bath Potters waxay sheegtaa inuu yahay Norwiiji.
mixed-potash-soda-feldspar-about-7-uyikr: Feldspar potash-soda isku-dhafan (qiyaastii 7% K2O, 5% Na2O) oo ka yimid warshadda flotation ee Sibelco ee Finland. Kani waa ''FFF'' ee Potclays, Potterycrafts, Valentine iyo CTM iibiyaan; magacu wuxuu u taagan yahay Finnish Flotation Feldspar.
finnish-feldspar-quartz-pegmatite-that-p: Pegmatite feldspar-quartz ah oo Finland ah oo Potclays u iibiso beddelka Forshammar feldspar oo hadda aan la heli karin. Silica-diisa badan ayaa ka dhigta inuu u dhaqmo sida Cornish stone in ka badan feldspar dhab ah.
the-nepheline-syenite-sold-in-the-1x77jq: Nepheline syenite-ka laga iibiyo UK waa Norwiiji, oo leh K2O iyo Na2O qiyaas ahaan isle''eg. Habab Maraykanku waxay u qaataan A270 Kanadiyaan ah (K2O 4.8, Na2O 10.5), sidaas darteed labadu isma beddeli karaan iyada oo aan dib loo xisaabin.
fine-dust-low-in-free-silica-1tgmsj5: Boodh jilicsan; silica xor ah wuu ku yar yahay laakiin iska ilaali neefsashadiisa.
natural-cornish-stone-is-no-longer-1o4yc: Cornish stone-ka dabiiciga ah hadda lama qodo, sidaas darteed alaab-qeybiyeyaasha UK hadda waxay iibiyaan beddel. the-leadless-frit-most-used-in-r48r5w: Frit-ka aan rasaas (lead, Pb) lahayn ee ugu isticmaalka badan glaze-yada earthenware ee UK: calcium borosilicate leh qiyaastii 19% B2O3. Xadka gubidda 900-1050 °C (Bath Potters) ama 950-1150 °C (Potclays).
not-classified-ctm-standard-borax-frit-1: Lama kala saarin (CTM Standard Borax Frit SDS 36, oo loo isticmaalay u-dhigme ahaan); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
potterycrafts-standard-borax-frit-a-gene: Standard borax frit-ka Potterycrafts, frit aan rasaas lahayn oo ujeeddo guud leh oo loogu talagalay glaze-yada earthenware. Ballaarasho 8.3 x 10^-6/°C, xadka gubidda 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2953-u: Lama kala saarin (Potterycrafts SDS P2953; in ka yar 1% quartz); neefsashada boodhka muddo dheer waxay kordhisaa khatarta cudurka sambabada.
soft-fluid-high-expansion-alkaline-frit-: Alkaline frit jilicsan, qulqul badan, ballaarasho sare leh oo loogu talagalay glaze-yada crackle iyo raku iyo buluugga copper ee alkaline. Ballaarasho 13.4 x 10^-6/°C, xadka gubidda 880-1060 °C.
contains-barium-about-7-bao-soluble-1xab: Waxaa ku jira barium (qiyaastii 7% BaO); alkaline frit biyaha ku milma, iska ilaali liqidda.
newer-uk-high-alkaline-frit-with-1swirl0: Frit alkaline badan oo UK ah oo cusub, leh soda iyo potash qiyaas ahaan isle''eg (qiyaastii 17% midkiiba) oo aan barium lahayn; loogu talagalay glaze-yada crackle iyo buluugga copper. Xadka gubidda 860-1060 °C.
very-soluble-alkaline-frit-avoid-ingesti: Alkaline frit aad biyaha ugu milma; iska ilaali liqidda.
sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-about-25-a: Sodium borosilicate frit leh qiyaastii 25% B2O3 oo ku dhowaad aan lime lahayn, lagu taliyo glaze-yada turquoise ee copper. Ballaarasho 6.9 x 10^-6/°C, xadka gubidda 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2961-b: Lama kala saarin (Potterycrafts SDS P2961); neefsashada boodhka muddo dheer waxay kordhisaa khatarta cudurka sambabada.
uk-fritted-calcium-borate-used-in-nlgcqo: Calcium borate frit ah oo UK ah oo loo isticmaalo meesha colemanite ama Gerstley borate (qiyaastii 50% B2O3, 26.5% CaO). Ballaarasho 6.1 x 10^-6/°C, xadka gubidda 1050-1160 °C. Potterycrafts waa ay haysay October 2026.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2954-b: Lama kala saarin (Potterycrafts SDS P2954); neefsashada boodhka muddo dheer waxay kordhisaa khatarta cudurka sambabada.
potclays-calcium-borate-frit-long-establ: Calcium borate frit-ka Potclays, ''oo muddo dheer loo yaqaannay beddelka colemanite ee glaze-yada''. Frit qoyan oo qallafsan; xadka gubidda 800-1100 °C, looma isticmaalo gubid degdeg ah.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Lama kala saarin (Potterycrafts P2954 SDS oo u dhigma; warqadda calcium borate frit ee Bath Potters waxay sheegaysaa inaan calaamadeyn loo baahnayn); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
ctm-s-calcium-borate-frit-on-1ttusd1: Calcium borate frit-ka CTM, oo la iibinayay ugu yaraan ilaa 2019, December 2025-na ''aan la heli karin''. not-classified-ctm-sds-37-avoid-o1fm3n: Lama kala saarin (CTM SDS 37); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.

uk-flint-is-calcined-flint-pebble-6yaur1: ''Flint''-ka UK waa dhagax flint ah oo la dubay (calcined), ma aha quartz la shiiday: qiyaastii 96% SiO2 oo leh 1.3% CaO iyo 1.3% LOI. respirable-crystalline-silica-including-: Silica kiristaal ah oo la neefsan karo, oo ay ku jirto xoogaa cristobalite ah; isticmaal respirator (maaskarada neefsashada) ku habboon.

imerys-s-safety-data-sheet-2013-15ms3kd: Warqadda xogta badbaadada ee Imerys (2013) ma kala saarto, waxayna sheegtaa in ka yar 1% quartz la neefsan karo; iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.

the-potash-feldspar-of-spain-s-7emvi0: Potash feldspar-ka summadda ugu weyn ee walxaha ceeriin ee dhoobada ee Isbaanya. Inkastoo magaciisu sidaas yahay, wuxuu leeyahay oo kaliya 7.5% K2O iyo 3.75% Na2O iyo silica dheeraad ah, sidaas darteed waa flux ka daciifsan potash spar dhab ah.

high-in-free-quartz-about-75-1feyvbz: Quartz xor ah oo badan (qiyaastii 75% SiO2 guud ahaan); boodhka waxaa ku jira silica kiristaal ah oo la neefsan karo. Iska ilaali neefsashadiisa.

kaolin-dust-may-contain-a-little-15eorz7: Boodh kaolin; waxaa ku jiri kara wax yar oo silica kiristaal ah (quartz). Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.

sds-for-potash-feldspar-k200bl-scott-190: SDS-ka Potash Feldspar K200BL (Scott Chemicals, 2021): feldspar 90-98%, quartz 2-10%. Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.

Wuu ka qallafsan yahay carbonate-ka, sidaas darteed wuxuu samayn karaa dhibco. Qiyaastii 5% wixii ka badan wuxuu bixin karaa dusha bir u eg oo madow oo aan ku habboonayn weelasha cuntada.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-h400-very-toxi: Digniin (Potterycrafts SDS): H400 aad u sun ah nolosha biyaha; kala-saarka la mideeyay ee EU waa H400 iyo H410. SDS-yada Maraykanka (Laguna, oo ka yimid Phibro) waxay bixiyaan H302 waxyeello leh haddii la liqo. Qiiqa copper ee kiln-ka kulul wuxuu keenaa qandhada qiiqa birta (metal fume fever); hawo ka saar kiln-ka.
basic-copper-carbonate-a-green-powder-sh: Basic copper carbonate, budo cagaar ah oo leh 55–57% copper, sidaas darteed qiyaastii 70% CuO; inta kale (qiyaastii 30%) waxay u baxdaa CO₂ iyo biyo qiyaastii 290 C (554 F). Ma dhalaalo. Wuxuu bixiyaa midab ka siman black copper oxide. Flux firfircoon; wuxuu qiiq bixiyaa qiyaastii 815 C (1500 F) wuxuuna ku dhici karaa weelasha u dhow, gaar ahaan glaze-yada tin-ka ku cad.
warning-ceramic-color-chemical-sds-00909: Digniin (Ceramic Color & Chemical SDS 00909-A, 2024-09, oo laga iibiyo The Ceramic Shop): H302 waxyeello leh haddii la liqo; H332 waxyeello leh haddii la neefsado; H319 waxay keentaa xanaaq daran oo indhaha ah; H400/H410 aad u sun ah nolosha biyaha.
a-natural-source-of-iron-and-14y8gh2: Isha dabiiciga ah ee bir (iron) iyo titanium ee glaze-yada.
not-classified-ctm-sds-31-32-7ac3hh: Lama kala saarin (CTM SDS 31/32; in ka yar 0.1% quartz); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
magnetite-fe3o4-also-sold-as-magnetic-1j: Magnetite, Fe₃O₄, oo sidoo kale loo iibiyo magnetic iron oxide; noocyada qaar waa macdan dabiici ah oo la shiiday oo quartz leh. Buugaagta hore ee dhoobo-sameeyayaasha waxay black iron ku qoraan FeO, laakiin ferrous oxide looma iibiyo walax dhoobo-sameeye. Garaam-garaam wuxuu bixiyaa qiyaastii bir le''eg red iron oxide. Flux xoog leh marka reduction la gubayo. Inta badan wuu ka qallafsan yahay red iron oxide; shaandhee ama ball-mill ku shiid si aad uga hortagto dhibcaha.
not-classified-ctm-sds-66-avoid-17wgk3h: Lama kala saarin (CTM SDS 66); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
a-hydrated-form-of-iron-oxide-1pqopi1: Qaab iron oxide ah oo biyo leh (hydrated). Kuma milmo biyaha, walxo aad u yaryar.
not-classified-ctm-sds-73-synthetic-1e8x: Lama kala saarin (CTM SDS 73, yellow iron oxide la sameeyay); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
a-material-with-hydrated-iron-oxide-1kzy: Walax leh iron oxide biyo leh iyo dhoobo. Mararka qaar waxaa loo yaqaan limonite (oo ah macdan iron oxide). Qaar badan waxay sidoo kale leeyihiin manganese.
danger-new-riverside-ochre-sds-natural-1: Khatar (New Riverside Ochre SDS): ochre dabiici ah oo leh 20–29% quartz (carcinogen category 1A marka la neefsado; wuxuu keeni karaa silicosis) iyo 1.5–4% manganese dioxide; iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
potters-manganese-dioxide-is-ground-ore-: Manganese dioxide-ka dhoobo-sameeyayaashu waa macdan la shiiday, badanaa qiyaastii 75% MnO₂ oo leh iron oxide, silica iyo alumina, sidaas darteed wuxuu bixiyaa oo kaliya qiyaastii 61% MnO. Oxygen ayuu marxalado ku lumiyaa marka uu kululaado, isagoo noqda Mn₂O₃ qiyaastii 450–600 C iyo Mn₃O₄ qiyaastii 750–1100 C; gaasku wuxuu keeni karaa xumbo. Bunni, iyo guduud glaze-yada alkaline; flux marka uu ku milmo dhalaalka. Manganese wuxuu qiiq bixiyaa kulaylka sare, sidaas darteed hawo ka saar kiln-ka.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-also-laguna-pr: Digniin (Potterycrafts SDS; sidoo kale Laguna/Prince BrickOx SDS; EU la mideeyay): H302 waxyeello leh haddii la liqo; H332 waxyeello leh haddii la neefsado. Noocyada macdanta waxaa sidoo kale ku jiri kara silica kiristaal ah. Manganese wuxuu qiiq bixiyaa kulaylka sare, sidaas darteed hawo ka saar kiln-ka.
green-nickel-oxide-is-stoichiometric-nio: Green nickel oxide waa NiO stoichiometric ah, 78.5% nickel. Kiln-ka kuma kala dillaaco kumana dhalaalo (NiO wuxuu dhalaalaa qiyaastii 1955 C / 3550 F) wuxuuna u adkaystaa kulaylka, sidaas darteed isticmaal xaddi yar; wuxuu bixiyaa cagaar, bunni iyo cawl qabow, iyo buluug ama pink saldhigyada qaar.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-1vgqp: Khatar (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, GHS version 06/15): H317 waxay keeni kartaa xasaasiyad maqaarka ah; H334 waxay keeni kartaa xasaasiyad ama calaamadaha neefta (asthma) haddii la neefsado; H350 waxay keeni kartaa kansar (EU: H350i, marka la neefsado); H372 waxay waxyeelleysaa sambabada marka muddo dheer ama si joogto ah loo neefsado; H413 waxay u keeni kartaa waxyeello muddo dheer nolosha biyaha.
black-nickel-oxide-is-nio-with-kerajy: Black nickel oxide waa NiO oo leh xoogaa oxygen dheeraad ah (qiyaastii 76.4–77.6% nickel), ma aha Ni2O3 dhab ah. Oxygen-kaas ayuu lumiyaa oo wuxuu noqdaa green NiO qiyaastii 600–700 C (1100–1300 F), sidaas darteed glaze-ka wuxuu u dhaqmaa sida green nickel oxide, isagoo garaam kasta bixiya qiyaastii 2% NiO ka yar.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-wakl3: Khatar (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, GHS version 06/15, oo magacaabaysa noocyada calcined black nickel oxide A iyo F): H317 waxay keeni kartaa xasaasiyad maqaarka ah; H334 waxay keeni kartaa xasaasiyad ama calaamadaha neefta (asthma) haddii la neefsado; H350 waxay keeni kartaa kansar (EU: H350i, marka la neefsado); H372 waxay waxyeelleysaa sambabada marka muddo dheer ama si joogto ah loo neefsado; H413 waxay u keeni kartaa waxyeello muddo dheer nolosha biyaha.
pr6o11-the-dark-brown-form-that-n56z4j: Pr₆O₁₁, qaabka bunniga madow ee la iibiyo. Halkan waxaa loo xisaabiyay Pr₂O₃, qaabka praseodymium uu ku yeesho glaze-ka; oxygen-ka dheeraadka ah (3.1%) iyo ilaa 1% qoyaan waxaa loo xisaabiyaa luminta gubidda (LOI). Kiln-ka kuma dhalaalo (qiyaastii 2183 C); 931 C-da inta badan la sheego waa ta birta. Midabeeye daciif ah: 5–8% wuxuu bixiyaa cagaar lime ilaa cagaar-jaalle, waxaana inta badan loo isticmaalaa stain-yada jaallaha ah ee zircon-praseodymium.
low-hazard-but-sdss-disagree-fujifilm-d1: Khatar yar, laakiin SDS-yadu isma waafaqsana: Fujifilm Wako (2023) khatar ma aha sida GHS; LTS (2023) Digniin, H315, H319, H335 (xanaaq maqaarka, indhaha iyo marinnada neefta). Inta badan wargeliyeyaasha ECHA ma kala saaraan praseodymium oxide.
natural-rutile-milled-for-ceramics-about: Rutile dabiici ah oo loo shiiday dhoobada: qiyaastii 95% TiO2 oo leh xaddi yar oo silica, zircon, vanadium, bir (iron) iyo chromium ah. Noocyada hadda ee Maraykanka iyo UK waxay leeyihiin in ka yar 1% iron oxide, ma aha 9–10%-ka inta badan loo maleeyo. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa kala-duwanaanshaha midabka (variegation) tan ilaa bunni, opacity iyo korriinka kiristaalada, iyo cobalt, copper ama bir la socda midabo jajaban.
tam-ceramics-sds-2018-warning-eye-1yrsyy: TAM Ceramics SDS (2018): Digniin, xanaajiye indhaha iyo maqaarka (Category 2; H319, H315); boodhku wuxuu xanaajin karaa marinnada neefta. Potterycrafts SDS: lama kala saarin. Liiska Carc. 2 ee EU ee budada TiO2 la neefsado waa la buriyay (2022, waxaana la xaqiijiyay 2025).
tio2-added-at-about-2-10-wa6in9: TiO₂. Waxaa lagu daraa qiyaastii 2–10% (4% waa caadi) kala-duwanaanshaha midabka, opacity iyo korriinka kiristaalada, iyo bir ama cobalt la socda midabo jajaban. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku jiraa liiska walxaha sida Titanium Oxide, habab u xisaaba saldhigga.
vanadium-pentoxide-v2o5-an-orange-yellow: Vanadium pentoxide, V2O5, budo oranji-jaalle ah, qiyaastii 99% saafi ah. Wuxuu dhalaalaa 690 C (1274 F) wuxuuna u shaqeeyaa flux; keligiis wuxuu bixiyaa jaalle daciif ah ilaa bunni, tin oxide ama zircon la socdana jaalle ka xoog badan. Aad buu u sun yahay: xiro respirator, iska ilaali boodhka oo hawo ka saar kiln-ka.
danger-eu-gb-harmonised-classification-h: Khatar. Kala-saarka la mideeyay ee EU/GB: H301 sun haddii la liqo, H330 dila haddii la neefsado, H335 xanaaq marinnada neefta, H341 looga shakisan yahay inay keento cillado hidde ah, H350 waxay keeni kartaa kansar, H361fd looga shakisan yahay inay waxyeelleyso dhalmada ama ilmaha aan weli dhalan, H362 waxyeello carruurta naaska nuugta, H372 waxyeello sambabada marka si joogto ah loola kulmo, H411 sun u ah nolosha biyaha. SDS-yada Maraykanku waxay bixiyaan koox wax yar ka khafiifsan laakiin weli halis ah (H302+H332, H319, H335, H341, H351, H361, H372, H411).
stannic-oxide-sno2-about-99-5-14e5t2w: Stannic oxide, SnO₂, qiyaastii 99.5% saafi ah. Kuma dhalaalo kulaylka glaze-ka (wuxuu dhalaalaa qiyaastii 1630 C / 2966 F); wuxuu ku sii jiraa walxo yaryar oo sabbaynaya, taas oo glaze-ka ka dhigta mid aan gudihiisa la arki karin: 4–6% wuxuu bixiyaa cad nus-opaque ah, 8–10% opacity buuxda, iyo cad diirran majolica-da kulaylka hoose. Si liidata ayuu u opacify-gareeyaa reduction iyo cone 10, halkaas oo uu ku bilaabo milmid. Wuxuu caawiyaa samaynta casaanka copper ee reduction; raad chrome ah marka lagu daro wuxuu noqdaa pink.
not-classified-no-signal-word-on-n0mh1: Lama kala saarin (erey calaamad ah ma leh) SDS-yada hadda (Potterycrafts 2025, Laguna 2014). Neefsashada boodhka sanado badan waxay keeni kartaa stannosis, xaalad sambabeed oo aan halis ahayn.
zirconium-dioxide-zro2-zirconia-rarely-u: Zirconium dioxide, ZrO₂ (zirconia). Dhif ayaa si ceeriin ah loogu isticmaalaa glaze-yada: inta badan habab waxay u baahan yihiin zircon (Zircopax, Superpax), oo ah zirconium silicate. Kuma milmo biyaha; wuxuu opacify-gareeyaa maadaama uusan dhalaalin kulaylka glaze-ka, wuxuu adkeeyaa dhalaalka wuxuuna yarayn karaa crazing.
not-classified-ati-zirconium-oxide-sds-1: Lama kala saarin (ATI zirconium oxide SDS, EU); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
zirconium-silicate-zrsio4-67-2-zro2-i6z2: Zirconium silicate, ZrSiO₄: 67.2% ZrO₂ iyo 32.8% SiO₂. Waxaa loo iibiyaa Zircopax, Superpax, Excelopax, Ultrox iyo Zircosil, oo inta badan ku kala duwan cabbirka walxaha yaryar. Opacifier-ka caadiga ah: qiyaastii 4–7% nus-opaque, 8–15% ama ka badan opacity buuxda; 1–3% inta badan wuxuu adkeeyaa glaze-ka. Wuxuu shaqeeyaa reduction, si ka duwan tin oxide. Silica-diisa waxaa lagu daraa xisaabta glaze-ka.
not-classified-ctm-zirconium-silicate-sd: Lama kala saarin (CTM zirconium silicate SDS 29; in ka yar 0.01% silica kiristaal ah oo la neefsan karo); wax yar ayuu shucaac (radioactive) leeyahay (uranium 285–343 ppm, thorium 116–157 ppm), sidaas darteed iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
synthetic-red-iron-oxide-is-about-1i5e3s: Red iron oxide-ka la sameeyay waa qiyaastii 99% Fe₂O₃; red iron oxides-ka dabiiciga ah (hematite la shiiday) way ka daciifsan yihiin, qiyaastii 76–95% Fe₂O₃ oo leh dhoobo, quartz iyo carbonate. Xasiliye kulaylka u adkaysta oxidation ilaa qiyaastii cone 7–8, halkaas oo uu ku bilaabo inuu oxygen lumiyo oo noqdo flux; reduction-ka wuxuu goor hore noqdaa FeO waana flux xoog leh.
synthetic-grade-not-classified-as-hazard: Nooca la sameeyay: looma kala saarin khatar (Potterycrafts SDS P3441, rev 2025-10). Noocyada macdanta dabiiciga ah waxaa lagu calaamadeeyaa Digniin, H373 (waxyeello sambabada marka muddo dheer la neefsado) maxaa yeelay waxaa ku jira quartz la neefsan karo.
wyoming-sodium-bentonite-the-standard-gl: Wyoming sodium bentonite, sii-hayaha glaze-ka ee caadiga ah; 1–3% wuxuu ka ilaaliyaa glaze-ka inuu hoos u dego, laakiin wixii ka badan wuxuu ka dhigaa mid si tartiib ah u qalla oo u nugul crawling. Wuxuu ku daraa xoogaa bir (iron), soda iyo magnesia ah.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-qzjuvp: Khatar: H350 waxay keeni kartaa kansar (marka la neefsado) iyo H372 waxay waxyeelleysaa sambabada marka muddo dheer ama si joogto ah loola kulmo, maxaa yeelay waxaa ku jira silica kiristaal ah (Volclay 325: quartz ilaa 6%, cristobalite ilaa 2%). Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
a-water-washed-white-firing-smectite-11s: Dhoobo smectite ah oo biyo lagu dhaqay, cad ku gubta (magnesium aluminium silicate) oo loo isticmaalo 1–2% sii-haye iyo adkeeye glaze ah iyo plasticizer porcelain iyo jirka kale ee aan plastic ahayn. Si buuxda biyo ugu qoy ka hor intaadan ku darin walxaha kale. Vanderbilt ma daabacdo falanqayn oksaydh ee nooca T; tani waa tan VEEGUM caadiga ah, oo lagu xusay patent 1964, sidaas darteed u qaado qiyaas. Magnesium badan ayuu leeyahay (MgO 13.7%), si ka duwan sodium bentonite.
not-classified-vanderbilt-sds-2023-no-17: Lama kala saarin (Vanderbilt SDS 2023): erey calaamad ah ma leh. Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka; neefsasho muddo dheer waxay keeni kartaa dhaawac sambabada.
a-purified-hectorite-magnesium-lithium-s: Dhoobo hectorite ah oo la sifeeyay (magnesium-lithium smectite), oo hadda loo iibiyo Elementis Bentone MA; wuxuu sii haystaa glaze-yada wuxuuna adkeeyaa lakabka qallalan iyada oo aan qallajinta u gaabin sida CMC. Si ka duwan bentonite, wuxuu keenaa magnesia, lime iyo xoogaa lithia ah halkii uu ka keeni lahaa alumina iyo bir (iron).
not-classified-elementis-sds-2016-not-j7: Lama kala saarin (Elementis SDS 2016): ma aha walax khatar ah sida GHS. Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
an-organic-gum-that-binds-and-pg9ere: Xabag organic ah oo isku xirta oo adkeysa lakabka glaze-ka qallalan, gaabisa qallajinta oo caawisa burushka; gubidda ayay ku gubataa, waana laga reebaa kiimikada. Dareerayaashu way xumaadaan, sidaas darteed samee batch yar ama ku dar walax ilaalisa (preservative).
warning-may-form-combustible-dust-concen: Digniin: hawada waxay ku samayn kartaa boodh urursan oo gubta (OSHA combustible dust). Kala-saar khatar caafimaad ma leh.
a-soluble-salt-used-in-tiny-1g4n6wq: Milix biyaha ku milanta oo xaddi aad u yar loo isticmaalo si glaze-ka qoyan loo flocculate-gareeyo (loo adkeeyo) si uu u sii sabbeeyo; waa hagaajin habka shaqada, ma aha qayb dhab ah oo glaze-ka ka mid ah. Inta badan miisaankiisu waa biyo iyo sulfate, oo ka baxa gubidda.
not-classified-giles-chemical-sds-2020-1: Lama kala saarin (Giles Chemical SDS 2020): ma aha walax khatar ah sida GHS.
manganese-ii-carbonate-a-pinkish-tan-nrm: Manganese(II) carbonate, budo midab pink-tan ah; noocyada ganacsigu waa qiyaastii 44% manganese (MnCO3 saafi ah waa 47.8%). Waxaa loo xisaabiyaa MnO, qiyaastii 57% MnO iyo qiyaastii 43% luminta gubidda maadaama uu CO2 bixiyo qiyaastii 200 C; wuxuu bixiyaa bunni, iyo guduud ilaa plum glaze-yada alkaline.
danger-h372-causes-damage-to-organs-18gj: Khatar: H372, waxay waxyeelleysaa xubnaha jirka (habdhiska dareemayaasha) marka muddo dheer ama si joogto ah loo neefsado (Laguna SDS, rev. 2014-03; sidoo kale wargelinta ECHA ee ugu caansan). Iska ilaali boodhka oo hawo ka saar kiln-ka.
basic-nickel-carbonate-a-light-green-14r: Basic nickel carbonate, budo cagaar khafiif ah oo loo iibiyo qiyaastii 46% nickel. Wuxuu bixiyaa cagaar, cawl iyo bunni qabow, waxaana loo isticmaalaa jilcinta buluugga cobalt.
danger-h302-h332-harmful-if-swallowed-1e: Khatar: H302+H332 waxyeello leh haddii la liqo ama la neefsado; H315; H317 xasaasiyad maqaarka ku keena; H334 xasaasiyad marinnada neefta ku keena; H341; H350i waxay keeni kartaa kansar marka la neefsado; H360 waxay waxyeelleyn kartaa dhalmada ama ilmaha aan weli dhalan; H372. sold-to-potters-as-ground-natural-1ijf67: Dhoobo-sameeyayaasha waxaa loogu iibiyaa macdan chromite dabiici ah oo la shiiday oo ka timid Koonfur Afrika, ma aha chromate dhab ah: qiyaastii 46% Cr2O3 iyo 26% FeO, oo leh alumina iyo magnesia. not-classified-under-ghs-vibrantz-iron-h: Lama kala saarin sida GHS (Vibrantz ''Iron Chromite Chromox 7901'' SDS, rev. 2023-01, sida Sounding Stone u iibiso; sidoo kale Prince Minerals SDS ee Laguna). a-rare-earth-oxide-used-as-1yx4z2x: Rare-earth oxide loo isticmaalo opacifier kulayl hooseeya iyo midabeeye daciif ah, oo bixiya kareem ilaa tan-jaalle ama oranji gaar ahaan titanium ama rutile la socda. Si degdeg ah ayuu hoos ugu dega, sidaas darteed glaze-ku wuxuu u baahan yahay sii-haye.
not-classified-pace-sds-2025-not-1ao5xnh: Lama kala saarin (PACE SDS 2025): ma aha walax khatar ah sida GHS. Alaab-qeybiyeyaasha qaar waxay qoraan xanaaq indhaha, maqaarka iyo marinnada neefta (H315, H319, H335). Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
natural-red-iron-oxide-mined-at-767hen: Red iron oxide dabiici ah oo laga qoday Tierga, Isbaanya: qiyaastii 87% Fe2O3 oo leh xoogaa silica, dolomite iyo mica ah, sidaas darteed garaam-garaam wax yar ayuu ka daciifsan yahay red iron oxide-ka la sameeyay. Isagoo ceeriin ah waa oranji-casaan ifaya; waxaa ku jira xoogaa milix biyaha ku milma ah.
warning-h373-may-cause-damage-to-1vkarkk: Digniin: H373, waxay waxyeelleyn kartaa sambabada marka muddo dheer ama si joogto ah loo neefsado, maxaa yeelay waxaa ku jira quartz la neefsan karo (Promindsa Micronox R series SDS, rev. 2015-01, oo Laguna qeybiso).
fine-silicon-carbide-about-600-mesh-vaaz: Silicon carbide jilicsan (qiyaastii 600 mesh, FFF) wuxuu bixiyaa reduction meel gaar ah gubidda oxidation, tusaale ahaan casaanka copper; xaddi badan ama shiidid ka qallafsan waxay sameeyaan dusha xumbo leh oo godad leh. Waa laga reebaa kiimikada, inkastoo haddii si buuxda loo gubo uu u beddeli lahaa qiyaastii 1.5 jeer miisaankiisa oo silica ah.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-15vqfe: Khatar: H350 waxay keeni kartaa kansar (marka la neefsado), raad silica kiristaal ah darteed (Washington Mills SDS 2025). SDS-yada hore ee alaab-qeybiyeyaashu waxay sidoo kale qoraan xanaaq maqaarka, indhaha iyo marinnada neefta (H315, H319, H335). Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
commercial-stains-are-pre-fired-insolubl: Stain-yada ganacsigu waa midabyo hore loo gubay oo aan milmin; ka-koobnaantoodu waa sir shirkadeed, waxayna midabeeyaan dhalada iyagoo ku sii sabbaynaya, sidaas darteed waa laga reebaa kiimikada. varies-by-stain-check-the-sds-rfi082: Wuu ku kala duwan yahay stain-ka: hubi SDS-ka stain-ka gaarka ah. SDS-yada Mason waxay stain-yo badan (tusaale 6600 Best Black) ku qoraan lama kala saarin, laakiin stain-yada waxaa ku jiri kara cobalt, nickel, chromium, manganese, vanadium, praseodymium ama cadmium/selenium (casaanka iyo oranjiga inclusion). crocus-martis-sold-by-us-suppliers-nv7ve: Crocus martis-ka alaab-qeybiyeyaasha Maraykanku maanta iibiyaan waa red iron oxide la sameeyay oo aad loo shiiday (Bayferrox 180) oo leh midab buluug-guduud ah, ma aha iron sulfate-kii hore ee la dubay. not-classified-as-hazardous-lanxess-bayf: Looma kala saarin khatar (xogta Lanxess Bayferrox 180 M; midab red iron oxide ah). Boodh dhib leh; SDS-kii hore ee Laguna wuxuu xusay qiyaastii 4% silica aan kiristaal ahayn (amorphous).

not-classified-under-ghs-prince-minerals: Lama kala saarin sida GHS (Prince Minerals ''Granular Ilmenite'' SDS, rev. 2014-10, oo Laguna iyo Axner qeybiyaan); waxaa ku jira ilaa 0.5% quartz.
bentonite-sold-by-carl-ja-ger-lwhw4v: Bentonite ay iibiyaan Carl Jäger (Germany) iyo Bodmer Ton (Switzerland), falanqayn isku mid ahna Silica Nordic (Denmark): dhoobo montmorillonite ah oo bararta oo loo isticmaalo 0.5-2% (ilaa 3%) si glaze-yada loo sii hayo loona adkeeyo lakabka glaze-ka ceeriin. bentonite-dust-may-contain-crystalline-s: Boodhka bentonite waxaa ku jiri kara silica kiristaal ah (quartz ama cristobalite); iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
white-low-iron-bentonite-sold-by-kd46hw: Bentonite cad oo bir (iron) yar leh oo alaab-qeybiyeyaasha dhoobada Isbaanya (Prodesco, Marphil) u iibiyaan sii-haye glaze iyo plasticiser. contains-about-17-cristobalite-opal-c-1k: Waxaa ku jira qiyaastii 17% cristobalite/opal-C sida alaab-qeybiyuhu sheegay; cristobalite waa qaab silica kiristaal ah, sidaas darteed iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.
natural-sodium-bentonite-mined-and-proce: Sodium bentonite dabiici ah oo laga qoday laguna farsameeyay meel u dhow Miles, Queensland; dhoobo-sameeyayaasha waxaa u iibiya Northcote Pottery Supplies oo u iibisa ''Bentonite - Trubond'', waxaana loo isticmaalaa 1-3% si glaze-yada loo sii hayo.
unimin-tds-warns-the-product-contains-k4: Unimin TDS wuxuu ka digayaa in alaabta ay ku jirto silica kiristaal ah oo xor ah (quartz). Iska ilaali neefsashada boodhka.

use-permanent-labels-on-glaze-materials-: Isticmaal calaamado joogto ah walxaha glaze-ka iyo weelasha glaze-ka. small-amounts-of-epsom-salts-1-q1tjq9: Xaddi yar oo epsom salts ah, 1 - 2 qaaddo weyn 20 lbs. (rodol), ayaa walxaha glaze-ka ku sii haynaya sabbayn waxayna ka hortagaysaa cufan adag oo ku samaysma salka baaldiga.
glaze-tiles-can-be-made-with-1u67bt3: Test tile-yada glaze-ka waxaa lagu samayn karaa god 1/4 inji ah, kadibna lagu xiri karaa gacanta baaldiga glaze-ka. orton-s-older-chart-for-large-jgynh: Jaantuskii hore ee Orton ee cone-yada waaweyn ee lagu kululeeyay 150 °C saacaddii 100 °C-da ugu dambeysa, sida soo saarayaasha kiln-ka dib ugu daabacaan; tirooyinka hadda ee Orton ee cone-yada waaweyn ee xawaarahaas waxay kaga duwan yihiin ilaa 19 °C.
